General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part attaches to the top of the transmission case and receives and holds in place the button of the shift lever.
This housing is drilled for the 12mm Locating Bolt
NOTE: If you are installing this on a 85′-89′ Samurai you will need the 12mm locating bolt and a shift lever that has the 12mm locating bolt slot. If you are buying this for a 90′-95′ Samurai then your parts will swap over.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 Shift Lever Case
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
